title: Lord Jesus Think On Me
lyrics_original: From earthborn passions set me free
Let me Thy loving servant be
In all my pain and misery
Be Thou my Health and Life.
When on doth rush the enemy,
That, when the flood is past,
And share Thy joy at last.
To Father, Spirit, and to Thee
The strains of praise and love.

bible_verses.english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
Even so consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, think on me today and draw my heart close to Yours. Purge away my sins and free me from the worries that weigh me down. I lay my weariness at Your feet, trusting in Your promise of true and abiding rest. Be my peace in the midst of life's daily battles, and let my life reflect Your pure love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, think on me today and draw my heart close to Yours. Purge away my sins and free me from the worries that weigh me down. devotional.reflection_english: In the noise and stress of daily struggles, it is deeply comforting to know that Jesus remembers us. When we pray, "Lord Jesus, think on me," we are not begging a distant God to notice us, but inviting our loving Savior to cleanse our hearts and bear our burdens. He promises rest to the weary and freedom from the sins that entangle us. Today, let His gracious presence bring quietness to your soul amid life's battles.
